## Что изменилось / What changed

Describe the result and link the issue. State whether this changes proof semantics, data, or a heuristic model.

## Проверка / Validation

- [ ] Ran `python -m k22 verify --data data` and the relevant tests.
- [ ] New obstruction: exact family/hash, full matching and replayable certificate included.
- [ ] ML experiment: seeds, input hashes, equal-budget independent control and metric definitions included.
- [ ] No claims that UNKNOWN or known-core avoidance proves torsion-freedom.
- [ ] No credentials, private paths, executable model pickles or unrelated artifacts.

For code-only changes, mark inapplicable data/model items explicitly. Describe limitations and external compute used.
